description: Tell the editors of obligacyjnyinwestor.pl about a problem with this server: missing data, a value that looks wrong, a tool or field you needed but could not find, or a confusing tool description. Use it at most once per problem in a conversation. Describe only the data problem: no personal data and no copy of the user's conversation. Only a confirmation is returned; no reply is sent. Zgłoszenie braku albo błędu w danych.

code.description: Optional: series code or issuer id the problem concerns.

description.description: What is missing or wrong, in English or Polish, max 500 characters. Include the expected value and its source if you know them.

tool.description: Optional: tool the problem concerns, e.g. "get_bond".

name: report_gap
title: Report missing or wrong data
